k-4096.what: the far path multiplies by 4096 for 8192 (half the logarithm). KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 2 (40000000) the planted graph gives 3EB17218 and ln 2 lies between 3F317217 and 3F317218. Refused where the proof names the far path's last operation

add-for-mul.what: the last operation is k + p for k * p. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 1 the planted graph gives 2 (40000000) and ln 1 = 0. Refused where the proof meets the last operation at x = 1

coef-36.what: the z^3 coefficient is 36/105 for 35/105 = 1/3. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 15/16 (3F700000) the planted graph gives BD842D1B and ln x lies between BD842CC6 and BD842CC5. Refused where the levels the proof walked no longer are the graph's

hand-edited-graph.what: Graph.v with one blank added at the end of a line: the same graph for Coq, and not what emit_log32.py prints

prem-no-upper.what: LOG32 without x < 2^128. False, ARGUED with its last part MEASURED: x = 2^40960 is in the model's format32; its twelve square roots are exact powers of two and give y = 1024 (argued); from y = 1024 the graph's value before narrow is 13667.60 (MEASURED) and ln x is 28391.31. Refused where the proof takes the premise

prem-zero.what: LOG32 with 0 <= x for 0 < x. KNOWN FALSE at x = 0: the graph gives C6568D69 = -13731.35 (MEASURED) and Coq's ln 0 is 0 by its definition (READ: Rpower.ln is 0 outside 0 < x). Refused where the far path needs 0 < x

concl-round-down.what: LOG32 says the result is ln x rounded DOWN. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 2 (40000000) the graph gives 3F317218 and ln 2 rounded down is 3F317217. Refused where lemma F32 no longer fits

concl-correct.what: LOG32 claims the correctly rounded result. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 40014123 the graph gives 3F33F13D and the correctly rounded ln x is 3F33F13E (the first such input found going up from 2, after 82,211). Refused where lemma F32 no longer fits

concl-finite-64.what: LOG32_FINITE says the result is at most 64 in magnitude. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = FMAX32 (7F7FFFFF) the graph gives 42B17218 = 88.72. Refused where faithful_finite no longer fits

admitted.what: Log32.hstep (one level of the polynomial) ends with Admitted for its last step

trunc-axiom.what: the mean value step hz_pos is an Axiom of Trunc.v (the same text, its proof removed), used by the top theorem through atanh_trunc

other-statement.what: Log32.v states, under the name LOG32_ALL, the proposition True and proves that
